name: High Kinlord Rilis (Banished Cells II)

abilities.name: Daedric Bolt
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals minor magic damage.

abilities.name: Daedric Tempest
abilities.description: The boss causes lightning to strike two random players, dealing moderate flame damage and causing flame AoEs to appear under them for a short time, dealing moderate flame damage as indicated by red circles.

abilities.name: Summmon Daedroth
abilities.description: At regular intervals throughout the fight, the boss summons Daedroth and Feast orbs from the altar. Killing the Feast orbs is necessary to prevent him from healing, while killing the Daedroth will simplify the fight. Having three or more Daedroth alive at the time the boss is defeated will net players the hard mode achievement on Veteran.

abilities.name: Curse of Suffering and Curse of Dominance
abilities.description: The boss will levitate a random player in the air. When the player lands, they will be inflicted with a random curse as indicated by red or blue runes around them, dealing moderate magical damage over time. The damage can only be removed by going to the cleanse pads of the corresponding color at the side of the room.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: The boss teleports around to avoid your attacks.

related_quests: The Plan: Return to the Banished Cells and free its keepers from Daedric servitude.
Pledge: Banished Cells II: Explore The Banished Cells II and return Undaunted.
summary: This article is about the final boss in Banished Cells II. For the other variant seen in Banished Cells I, see High Kinlord Rilis (Banished Cells I). For the spirit seen at Castle Rilis, see High Kinlord Rilis XII. High Kinlord Rilis is the spirit of an ancient Altmer found in the Banished Cells I, of which he is the final boss. For all intents and purposes, he is actually a Xivilai, the form he takes when he possesses Keeper Cirion. He has a chance of dropping two unique items: the Staff of the Banished and the Corruptor's Maul. He also has a rare chance to drop the antiquity lead for the Silverthread Stitching mythic item fragment for Syrabane's Ward.
